قَشْبٌ inf. n. of قَشَبَ [q. v.] ―
-b2- [The explanations of this word by Golius and Freytag, by the former as an epithet applied in two contr. senses to a sword, and by the latter as a subst. (from a misstatement in the TK mentioned above), are erroneous.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
